THE LAND ACQUISITION AMENDMENT ACT
NO. 28 OF 1264 (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

My Ref. No. : VW/DS/LA/RDA/JPR/01. Land Ministry’s Ref. No. : 4-3/11/2017/UD/388. I hereby give notice under Sub-Section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act that the Government intends to acquire following lands which are required for a public purpose. Lot Nos. 01-233 (233 Lots) allotments in extent of 4.8902 Hectares of the land in Preliminary Plan No: Ya.2905 and dated 20.09.2018, Prepared by Senior Superintendent of Surveys of Jaffna on behalf of Surveyor General, Situated in the villages called Moolai, Vaddukoddai and Araly in the Grama Niladari Divisions are J/160 Araly West, J/161 Araly South, J/163 Araly East, J/164 Araly North, J/165 Vaddukoddai South, J/166 Vaddukoddai South West, J/171 Moolai in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Valikamam West in the Jaffna District Northern province.
